```{r,fig.height=7.5,fig.width=10}
levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit`)  <- gsub("acrAB-tolC","<i>acrAB-tolC</i>",levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit` )  )
levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit`)  <- gsub("ramR","<i>ramR</i>",levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit` )  )
levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit`)  <- gsub("ramA","<i>ramA</i>",levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit` )  )   

fix_hyphens <- function(x) {
gsub("-", "\u202F-\u202F", x)
} 
levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit`) <- fix_hyphens(levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit`)) 
remove_hyphen_spaces <- function(x) gsub("[\u202F\u00A0 ]*-[\u202F\u00A0 ]*", "-", x)

levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit`) <- remove_hyphen_spaces(levels(gwas_nons_freq$`Significant Hit`))

s_figure_3_B <- freq_plot(gwas_nons_freq,fig_text_size=2) +  s_figure_3_descriptive_plot_theme
```

# Legend
```{r}
# Legend from a real variable, using the same scale as the panel
data_legend <- function(data, var, scale, glyph = "rect", key_border = TRUE,
                        legend_theme = consistent_theme_sfigure_3) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  data <- data[!is.na(data[[var]]), , drop = FALSE]
  data[[var]] <- factor(data[[var]])
  outline <- if (glyph == "boxplot") "black" else NA        # outline only the boxplot symbol
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[var]], fill = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_bar(key_glyph = glyph, colour = outline, linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale + legend_theme
  if (!key_border) p <- p + theme(legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = NA))
  cowplot::get_legend(p)
}

# Genotype: all genotype columns combined, so both Present and Absent appear
genotype_long <- data.frame(genotype = as.vector(as.matrix(genotype_matrix)))

# Legends: the same scales as the panels (layout set by each scale's guide)
leg_clade      <- data_legend(df, "clade_I", clade_colors_scale_v)
leg_phylo      <- data_legend(df, "blbli_asr_cluster_renamed", cluster_scale_2_col_key)
leg_resistance <- data_legend(df, "blbli_dich", resistance_scale_key)
leg_mic        <- data_legend(df, "MVB_log_2", Log2_scale_gwas_s_figure_3)
leg_tn4401     <- data_legend(df, "tn4401_allele", tn4401_scale)
leg_kpc        <- data_legend(df, "KPC_allele", kpc_scale)
leg_genotype   <- data_legend(genotype_long, "genotype", genotype_scale_v)
leg_antibiotic <- data_legend(nn_data_melt, "variable", MVB_IR_scale,           # panel C
                              glyph = "boxplot", key_border = FALSE)

# One centered row of legends with equal gaps; titles aligned
row_legends <- function(legs, fig_w = 7.5, gap = 0.05) {
  w <- sapply(legs, function(g) grid::convertWidth(sum(g$widths),  "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
  h <- sapply(legs, function(g) grid::convertHeight(sum(g$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
  legs <- mapply(function(g, hi) gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, unit(max(h) - hi, "in"), pos = -1),
                 legs, h, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
  pad <- max((fig_w - sum(w) - gap * (length(legs) - 1)) / 2, 0)
  rel <- c(pad, as.vector(rbind(w, gap))[-2 * length(w)], pad)
  cells <- c(list(NULL),
             unlist(lapply(seq_along(legs), function(i)
               if (i < length(legs)) list(legs[[i]], NULL) else list(legs[[i]])),
               recursive = FALSE),
             list(NULL))
  out <- do.call(plot_grid, c(cells, list(nrow = 1, rel_widths = rel)))
  attr(out, "height_in") <- max(h)
  attr(out, "width_in")  <- sum(w) + gap * (length(legs) - 1)
  out
}

figure_3.legends <- row_legends(list(leg_clade, leg_phylo, leg_resistance, leg_mic,
                                     leg_tn4401, leg_kpc, leg_genotype, leg_antibiotic))
attr(figure_3.legends, "width_in")                    # must be <= 7.5

# Figure height = panels (fixed) + legend row (its own height); no stretching
panel_h  <- 4.75                                      # height of panels A-C (in)
legend_h <- attr(figure_3.legends, "height_in") + 0.1   # + small gap above legends
fig_w    <- 7.5
fig_h    <- panel_h + legend_h
c(fig_w = fig_w, fig_h = fig_h)
```

```{r ,fig.height=5.627835,fig.width=7.500000} 
  nrow = 2, labels = c("B", "C"), label_size = 12, align = "hv", label_x = -0.03)

s_figure_3 <- plot_grid(s_figure_3.FABC, figure_3.legends, nrow = 2,
                        rel_heights = c(panel_h, legend_h))
s_figure_3
```
